conditions.today: 6 AM—Up and at 'em! The early mountain birds will certainly be catching the worms. Springtime seems determined to make a premature debut, so just go with the flow and take in the panoramic view. Fast-softening snow will provide forgiving sliding surfaces as high temperatures zoar well into the 40s at the summit and approach an outlandish 70 in Teton Village. A slight reprieve from the solar radiation will come from gusty west winds in the 10 to 30 mph range. Winter isn't over yet, so don't sit around getting bored and lazy. It's going to be OK. Let this epic heatwave melt your rational mind because you just may find that skiing is much better when you go a little crazy. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: 6 AM-Greetings, Jackson Hole. Blazing sunshine and skyrocketing temperatures will make it feel like someone just pushed the alpine broil button. Get outta bed and come gorge on the goodies like a serious big mountain glutton. Near-record high temperatures will tickle 40 degrees at the summit and crest the 60-degree mark in Teton Village. A moderate breeze from the west will cool things just a bit as it clocks in between 5 and 30 mph. So, skip the screen time, slather on the sunscreen, and strip off a layer, because skiing is the most highly rewarding game, and everyone's a player. -Lege
